<Document id="nstack-components-reference" kind="plan" title="Token refresh review">

## Request flow

This document is the canonical authoring example. Every rich block contains one fenced JSON payload. All content here is proposed or existing context, not an implementation claim.

<Diagram id="refresh-flow" title="Refresh request" status="proposed">
```json
{"layout":"flow","nodes":[{"id":"client","label":"Client"},{"id":"auth","label":"Auth API"},{"id":"store","label":"Token store"}],"edges":[{"from":"client","to":"auth","label":"Refresh"},{"from":"auth","to":"store","label":"Rotate token"},{"from":"auth","to":"client","label":"Return access token"}]}
```
</Diagram>

<AnnotatedCode id="rotation-code" title="Rotate only after validation" status="proposed">
```json
{"language":"typescript","code":"async function refresh(token: string) {\n  const session = await validate(token);\n  return rotate(session);\n}","annotations":[{"line":2,"text":"Reject an expired or revoked session before writing."},{"line":3,"text":"Rotate the refresh token atomically."}]}
```
</AnnotatedCode>

<FileMap id="file-map" title="Change locations" status="proposed">
```json
{"files":[{"path":"src/auth/refresh.ts","change":"added","note":"Validate and rotate refresh tokens."},{"path":"tests/auth.test.ts","change":"modified","note":"Cover expired and reused tokens."},{"path":"src/auth/session.ts","change":"context","note":"Existing session storage boundary."}]}
```
</FileMap>

<BeforeAfter id="expiry-change" title="Make expiry explicit" status="proposed">
```json
{"before":{"label":"Existing return value","language":"typescript","code":"return { accessToken };"},"after":{"label":"Proposed return value","language":"typescript","code":"return { accessToken, expiresIn: 900 };"}}
```
</BeforeAfter>

{"options":[{"label":"HTTP-only cookie","reason":"Keep the refresh token outside JavaScript access.","selected":true},{"label":"Browser local storage","reason":"Simpler client integration but a broader exposure boundary.","selected":false}]}

{"regions":[{"label":"Account","kind":"header","content":"Session settings"},{"label":"Navigation","kind":"navigation","content":"Profile | Sessions | Security"},{"label":"Active sessions","kind":"content","content":"Current device, last active time, revoke control"},{"label":"Security note","kind":"footer","content":"Signing out revokes refresh access."}]}

<StateSequence id="refresh-states" title="Refresh interaction" status="proposed">
```json
{"states":[{"name":"Ready","description":"The session is valid.","regions":[{"label":"Session","kind":"content","content":"Signed in"}]},{"name":"Refreshing","description":"A refresh is in progress. Duplicate requests wait.","regions":[{"label":"Session","kind":"content","content":"Refreshing session..."}]},{"name":"Expired","description":"The refresh token was rejected. Ask the user to sign in.","regions":[{"label":"Session","kind":"control","content":"Sign in again"}]}]}
```

## HTTP and function contracts

API blocks describe contracts. They never send requests or execute functions. Schemas and examples are expandable.

<ApiContract id="refresh-http" title="Refresh endpoint" status="proposed">
```json
{"protocol":"http","method":"POST","path":"/v1/auth/refresh","auth":"HTTP-only refresh cookie. No credentials are entered in this viewer.","parameters":[{"name":"refresh_token","in":"cookie","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Opaque, rotating refresh token."}],"schema":{"type":"object","required":["accessToken","expiresIn"],"properties":{"accessToken":{"type":"string","description":"Short-lived access token."},"expiresIn":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"session":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"scopes":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}}}}},"examples":[{"kind":"request","body":{}},{"kind":"response","status":200,"body":{"accessToken":"example-only","expiresIn":900}},{"kind":"error","status":401,"body":{"code":"session_expired","message":"Sign in again."}}]}
```
</ApiContract>

<ApiContract id="refresh-function" title="Token rotation function" status="proposed">
```json
{"protocol":"function","name":"rotateSession","signature":"rotateSession(sessionId: string): Promise<TokenPair>","auth":"Called only after session validation.","parameters":[{"name":"sessionId","in":"argument","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Validated session identifier."}],"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"accessToken":{"type":"string"},"refreshToken":{"type":"string"}}},"examples":[{"kind":"request","body":{"sessionId":"example-session"}},{"kind":"response","body":{"accessToken":"example-access","refreshToken":"example-refresh"}},{"kind":"error","body":{"code":"rotation_conflict"}}]}
```
</ApiContract>
